Name: Number of secondary infections per smear-positive person-year
Description: Transmission parameter, fit to incidence in Pakistan.

Name: Relative infectiousness of smear-negative cases
Description: Infectiousness of smear-negative cases relative to smear-positive cases.

Name: Relative rate of progression to high-risk (early) infection, latent TB
Description: Parameter related to progression from latent TB.

Name: Rate of rapid progression during first two years after infection
Description: Rate of progression from recent latent infection to active TB.

Name: Rate of slow progression of remote TB infection
Description: Rate of reactivation from remote latent infection to active TB.

Name: Proportion of incident TB that is extrapulmonary
Description: Fraction of new active TB cases that are extrapulmonary.

Name: Proportion of incident pulmonary TB that is smear-positive
Description: Fraction of new pulmonary TB cases that are smear-positive.

Name: Mortality rate, smear-positive TB
Description: TB-specific death rate for untreated smear-positive cases.

Name: Mortality rate, smear-negative and extrapulmonary TB
Description: TB-specific death rate for untreated smear-negative and extrapulmonary cases.

Name: Natural cure rate, smear-positive TB
Description: Rate of spontaneous recovery for untreated smear-positive cases.

Name: Natural cure rate, smear-negative and extrapulmonary TB
Description: Rate of spontaneous recovery for untreated smear-negative and extrapulmonary cases.

Name: Size of informal sector that does not notify TB, relative to notifications
Description: Proportion of TB cases treated in the informal sector relative to notified cases.

Name: Treatment success proportion in 2008, notified cases
Description: Proportion of notified cases that are successfully treated.

Name: Treatment success proportion, informal sector
Description: Proportion of cases in the informal sector that are successfully treated.

Name: Relapse rate
Description: Rate at which treated/recovered individuals relapse to active TB.

Name: Population growth
Description: Annual population growth rate.

Name: Diagnostic rate
Description: A fitted parameter representing the rate of case detection, which varies by TB type and time period. Defined as (1/mean duration of infectiousness before diagnosis).
